hazards.name: Sandstorms
hazards.effect: Surface units and mines slowed; surface sensors -25%.
hazards.counter: Buried or domed structures; Atmospheric Processors calm the weather.

hazards.name: Hyperonic Radiation
hazards.effect: Phasers and transporters fail on the surface; new colonists sicken until adapted.
hazards.counter: Kelbonite-shielded structures; colonists adapt over time (Tau Cygna V).

hazards.name: Extreme Gravity
hazards.effect: No landings; ships in close orbit burn extra fuel; refineries take hull stress.

hazards.name: Toxic Atmosphere
hazards.effect: Unsealed outposts lose workers every cycle.

hazards.name: Thermionic Radiation
hazards.effect: Shields and sensors of ships in orbit degrade; shuttles can't land.

hazards.name: Extreme Heat
hazards.effect: Unprotected structures and units take heat damage every cycle.
hazards.counter: Shielded outposts only; kelbonite heat shielding.

hazards.name: Tidal Shear
hazards.effect: Ships and platforms that stray too close are torn apart.
hazards.counter: Keep collector platforms at a safe range.

hazards.name: Stellar Radiation
hazards.effect: Constant radiation damages crews and stations in the system.
